title: Bandit Patrol
description: Captain Bess Ordell posted this one herself, in guard hand, not a scribe's. A crew has been camped on the Millbrook road for four days and it doesn't behave like bandits - it let every cart through but one, stopped a single wagon, took one strongbox off it, and went back to sitting. She doesn't like a robbery that isn't hungry. Kill them or run them off the road; she wants the account closed either way.

objectives.description: Kill the crew that has been sitting the Millbrook road, not working it

notes: Threat: a road crew camped on the Millbrook road for four days, taking only one strongbox off one wagon and letting everything else through - not how bandits work a road. Giver motive: Captain Ordell posts it herself because the garrison can't spare men to sit and watch, and the crew's restraint bothers her more than an ordinary robbery would. Refusal: the crew stays camped and Ordell's account stays open. Soulstone touchpoint (do not extend elsewhere): the captain's irritation at a crew that took one strongbox and nothing else is the seed - never explained, never named as a pattern.
